_comment: Chapter II room by room, in play order (docs/CHAPTER2.md). Not a generator table yet: when a painting arrives, its row moves into tools/rooms/painted_rooms.py (traced ledges, spawns in panel pixels) and the scene is generated. validate_data.gd checks every id named here exists in the merged game + drafts. `stand_in` names existing paintings the composer can lay out a walkable draft from (docs/CHAPTER2_ART.md §4).

rooms.note: No fight worth the name: two ravens on the dead tree. Lazarus lies on the left third, under the milestone.
Both wardens wait under the arch: the door is open from the start. The sermon is nailed behind a bricked-up guardroom door.
A street of doorsteps, a waiter on each. Two shades in the windows above are the only real fight.
The stopped clock. Jonah on the east roof, the dry fountain is the rest point. Fork after: roofs / canal.
Vertical: chimneys, a broken belfry, shades guarding the high windows. No story here (forks carry none).
Red water under the footbridges; the first drowned climb out of it. No story here.
Naomi's lamp is the only light. The sailors' shrine is the rest point.
Hulls burned to the waterline. The bosun is the chapter's first elite. The Orpah's log is in a sealed cabin. Fork after: warehouses / breakwater.
Rotting grain, close quarters, low ceilings. No story here.
Open, wind, the red sea on both sides: a ranged room. A fall into the sea is a fall out of the room. No story here.
The spiral up the tower, two screens tall. The sealed relief order lies in a niche off the stair.
The lamp room, one screen tall. The Watchman stands between Elian and the fire.
